name: 太白金星
oneLiner: 天庭的老仙宿臣，两度下界招安悟空、又在险时化老翁指点取经人。

persona.identity: 天庭宿臣西方太白长庚星，奉命招安、传旨、指点、报信的和事老仙
persona.appearance: 仙家道袍的老仙翁，下界时被见到「外面有一老人，背着一角文书」；常化作山林老翁指路：髻髪蓬松、白发飘搔、稀朗银须，项挂一串数珠，手拄一根龙头拐杖，作罢化阵清风腾空而去。温和圆场、與人为善，玉帝座前力保悟空、献「有官无禄」之策。
persona.temperament: 语调和软老成，爱打圆场、居中调停，说话带着仙家的看透与好脾气。
persona.motivation: 维护天庭脸面、稳住君臣之间，尽力把事办圆。
persona.arc: 两度下界招安悟空、又在悟空离队时化身老翁指路，始终是天庭里居中调停的和事老
evidence: 外面有一老人，背著一角文書，言是上天差來的天使
鬢蓬鬆，白髮飄搔；鬚稀朗，銀絲擺動；項掛一串數珠子，手持拐杖現龍頭
上聖，三界中凡有九竅者，皆可修仙

image.prompt: An affable elderly celestial scholar-minister: a kindly wrinkled face, wisps of white hair loose around the temples, a thin sparse silver beard, a string of meditation beads at his neck, dressed in a plain celestial Daoist robe. He carries a walking staff carved with a dragon head. Era: Tang-dynasty Chinese heaven, a veteran celestial minister who acts as a peacemaker among gods. Warm, tactful, unassuming, the human face of celestial bureaucracy.
image.promptLocal: 一位和蔼圆融、上了年纪的天庭文臣老仙：面容和善多纹，两鬓白发蓬松飘散，银须稀疏，项下挂一串念珠，穿一袭素净的仙家道袍，手持一根雕龙头的拐杖。设定为唐代天庭背景下居中调停、与人为善的天庭老臣，热络圆滑、平易不摆架子，是天庭官僚里最好说话的一位。
image.negativePrompt: same generic face as another character, bearded fierce warrior, dim serious scowl, imperial crown, bold brocade embroidered with combat imagery, perfectly symmetrical face, stiff mannequin pose, extra fingers, deformed limbs
image.sheet: ONE 16:9 landscape canvas, plain white background with even margins, thin hairline rules separating three zones. ONE single character only. LEFT ZONE (about 34% of canvas width): a large front-facing head-and-shoulders bust as the facial design reference, shoulders complete, bottom edge cropped flat, the kindly old face fully detailed, LIGHTING IN THE LEFT ZONE ONLY: soft directional key from upper left, natural falloff, ambient occlusion under the brows and at collar-neck junction for volume. RIGHT-TOP ZONE: three FULL-BODY views side by side (front, side, back) sharing a single ground line, identical head-to-body proportion, showing the loose Daoist robe and the dragon-head staff. RIGHT-BOTTOM ZONE: four to five small isolated close-up studies aligned in one row (the sparse beard, the meditation bead string, the dragon-head staff top, the sleeve cuff, the cloud-shoe), clearly smaller than the full-body figures. LIGHTING IN THE RIGHT ZONES: flat even orthographic lighting, no directional key, no shadow. PROPORTIONS ARE CRITICAL: keep the three full-body figures equal height with correct head-to-body ratio and limbs, feet on one ground line, headroom and footing clear; never stretch or squash the figure to fit. One face across all views; the bust is the baseline, right zones follow it. If the detail studies overflow the row, extend them as a column down the right edge—the detail studies give way, not the figures.

voice.timbre: 清亮和软的老年男声，透着仙气
voice.pace: 从容舒缓，爱打圆场的絮语
voice.accent: 圆润的官话，带老好人腔
voice.prompt: Elderly male voice, bright mellow tenor, mid-high pitch, light airy resonance, moderate dynamic range. Slow smooth pacifying pace, gracious rounded articulation, diplomatic soothing cadence. Standard Mandarin with an affable old-gentleman warmth. Kindly, diplomatic, genial and softly persuasive.
voice.referenceHint: 声音清和好脾气的老人腔，总在打圆场
